prompt: A car travels $180$ miles in $3$ hours. What is the speed in **miles per hour**?
hint: Speed tells how far something moves in one unit of time. Here the unit of time is one hour.

hints.text: Speed tells how far something moves in one unit of time. Here the unit of time is one hour.
Divide the distance by the time to get the miles for each hour: work out $180 \div 3$.
$180 \div 3 = 60$, so the speed is $60$ miles per hour.

explanation: Speed is distance divided by time, because it measures the distance covered in each hour.
Put in the numbers from the problem: $180 \text{ miles} \div 3 \text{ hours}$.
Use the easier fact $18 \div 3 = 6$ to see that $180 \div 3$ is $60$.
The car's speed is $60$ miles per hour.
